# NextBody

NextBody builds medical-grade 3D body scanners for premium fitness operators in MENA and Southeast Asia.

## Products
- NextBody S30: Medical-grade 3D body scanner, 50+ metrics, R=0.96 DEXA correlation, 32-second scan.
- NextBody S20: Pro body composition analyzer, 30+ metrics, compact footprint for boutique gyms.

## Technology
3D Depth Mapping + 8-electrode Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis (BIA). Cloud-based member portal with trend tracking and coach dashboard.
